SparseTrack_fidelity_checklist.definition: Decompose dense target sets into sparse subsets via pseudo-depth estimation, then perform hierarchical association within each depth layer, processing closer objects first

pseudo_depth_estimation.method: Log-area based depth estimation from bounding box size
pseudo_depth_estimation.notes: Uses -log(area+1) as depth proxy; larger boxes = closer = smaller depth value

depth_layer_assignment.method: Quantile-based assignment into N depth layers
depth_layer_assignment.notes: Equal-sized layers based on depth value distribution

hierarchical_association.method: Process layers from closest (0) to farthest (N-1), with BYTE-style two-stage matching within each layer
hierarchical_association.notes: Within each layer: first match high-score dets, then match unmatched tracks with low-score dets

cross_layer_rescue.method: After hierarchical matching, attempt to match remaining unmatched trackers with unmatched detections from any layer
cross_layer_rescue.notes: Prevents excessive fragmentation from strict depth-layer constraints

overlap_threshold.notes: In current implementation, overlap threshold affects filtering but not the core hierarchical process

deviations.original: Would ideally use learned depth or multi-cue depth estimation
deviations.reason: No image data available; only bounding box coordinates provided

deviations.original: SparseTrack paper may use Re-ID features
deviations.reason: No appearance features in dataset; consistent with SORT/ByteTrack comparison
